title: WHEN TROUBLE SURROUNDS YOU
GOD WILL REVIVE YOUR SOUL
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace

scenes.a: Your heart is weary from constant trouble.
You feel completely surrounded, yet God’s Word speaks right into your darkest hour of fear:
Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
Lord, reach into this exhausting storm and revive this heavy soul. Stretch out your strong, saving hand.
Shield them from every enemy of peace and restore their strength. Cover their heart with quiet hope.
Amen. Lord, revive this weary heart when trouble surrounds them on every side.
